promise_band.headline: You Will Not Have To Chase Us
promise_band.body: Ask around the valley about contractors and you will hear the same two stories: the one who never called back after the estimate, and the one who disappeared halfway through. That is the bar we decided to clear. You get a real written scope and number before anything starts, you know which days we are coming, and if weather moves the schedule you hear it from us first — not after you have called twice. Every public review this business has says some version of the same thing, and that is not an accident.

signature_system.headline: Custom Finish Standards
signature_system.intro: Prezkop Builders is a custom finish contractor. That word matters — it is the difference between a deck that is built and a deck that is finished. Here is what it means on your job.

blocks.title: Building science before material selection
blocks.body: Flashing, drainage, ledger attachment, footing depth for our frost line. The parts of the job nobody sees are the parts that decide whether it is still right in fifteen years. We work those out during the design conversation, not while standing in your yard with a saw running.

blocks.title: The small jobs count as real jobs
blocks.body: Crawl space doors. Special-order window wells. Four stair treads and a handrail. A sidewalk that has to pitch away from the house properly. These are the calls other contractors let go to voicemail, and they are a large part of why our customers call us back for the big ones.

signature_system.steps_title: What we do that you should not have to ask for

steps.title: A written scope, not a napkin number
steps.body: You see what is included and what is not before you sign anything.

steps.title: You know which days we're coming
steps.body: And you hear from us when weather moves them, before you notice.

steps.title: The site gets cleaned up
steps.body: Every day, not just at the end. It is your home while we are in it.

guarantee.title: We are not finished until you say it is right
guarantee.body: No surprise line items and no invoice for work that was never discussed. If something is not right when we walk it together, we come back and make it right. That has been the arrangement since 2021.

about_block.headline: A Three-Person Crew Out Of Nanticoke
about_block.body: Josh Prezkop started this company in April 2021 as a custom finish contractor — hardwood floor refinishing first, then outdoor living, then full remodels and new construction. Five years later it is still Josh, Jake and Jimmy. Nobody gets handed off to a crew they have never met, and the owner who wrote your estimate is the one on your job site.

seo_body.headline: Remodeling & Outdoor Living In The Wyoming Valley
paragraphs: The housing stock in this valley is old. Coal-era homes with Southern Yellow Pine floors buried under three layers of carpet, porches that were framed before anyone thought about drainage, and additions from the seventies that were never flashed properly. Working on these houses is not the same as working on a new build, and it is most of what we do.

Outside, the season is short and the freeze-thaw is hard on everything. Decks, patios and concrete here have to be detailed for it — footings below frost, drainage that actually moves water, and materials chosen for the winter rather than the showroom. That is the part of the job that decides whether you are calling someone back in five years.

faqs.q: Will you take small jobs, or only full remodels?
faqs.a: We take small jobs. A lot of our work starts as four stair treads, a set of crawl space doors, or a section of sidewalk. Custom finish work is the business — the size of the job is not the filter.

faqs.q: How long does a deck or patio project take?
faqs.a: Most residential decks and patios run one to three weeks on site depending on size, footings and whether there is demolition first. Northeastern PA weather is the biggest variable, and we tell you when it moves the schedule rather than letting you find out.

faqs.q: Can you refinish old floors, or do they need replacing?
faqs.a: Most of the time they can be refinished. We handle all traditional hardwood and softwood species including Southern Yellow Pine — the heart pine common in older coal-region homes — plus oak, maple, hickory, poplar, chestnut, cherry and walnut. We can tell you on the consultation whether there is enough thickness left to sand.

faqs.q: What does hardwood refinishing actually involve?
faqs.a: Sanding through three progressively finer grits, hand scraping the edges and corners, a water-pop to open the grain for better stain penetration, an oil-based stain, then usually three to four coats of a high-quality water-based top coat. You choose the sheen. Oil-based finish is available if you prefer it.
